name: Waseda University
description: Waseda University is a private university in Shinjuku, Tokyo, founded in 1882 by Okuma Shigenobu. It has 13 undergraduate schools and the largest international student body of any Japanese university.
whyIncluded: Waseda has run a Singapore office since 2004, the Public Service Commission places scholars at Waseda and visited it in 2025 to expand opportunities for scholarship holders, and Japan is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: Waseda publishes only a total (about ¥1,000,000-¥2,000,000 a year for accommodation and living expenses, SILS applicants page), not a breakdown. Figures are JASSO 2023 Lifestyle Survey of Privately-Financed International Students (令和5年度私費外国人留学生生活実態調査, table 7-4), Tokyo average monthly spending in ¥1,000s: housing 57 + utilities 7, food 37, commuting 6, personal = hobbies/leisure 10 + other daily costs 10. Excludes study/research costs (56, includes tuition) and insurance/medical (3).

programmes.name: English-based Undergraduate Program in Science and Engineering
programmes.notes: School of Fundamental Science and Engineering. Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,584,000 = ¥1,784,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition. Other fees = lab fee ¥60,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 per year.

programmes.name: School of Law
programmes.notes: School of Law row of the 2026 undergraduate fee table. Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,040,000 = ¥1,240,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the engineering entry). Other fees per year = reading-room library fee ¥700 + academic society annual fee ¥2,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000; the ¥5,000 academic society entry fee is paid once. Japanese-taught 4-year degree. 2024 and 2025 tables show the same amounts.

programmes.name: Waseda Law School (Juris Doctor, 法曹養成専攻)
programmes.notes: 法曹養成専攻 (Graduate School of Law, Legal Practice major) row of the 2026 master's and professional degree fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,143,000 = ¥1,443,000, the same as tuition in years 2 and 3, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the other Waseda entries). Other fees per year = practical-training/seminar fee ¥120,000 + student association annual fee ¥2,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥125,000; the ¥5,000 student association entry fee is paid once. Standard duration 3 years (2 years for students entering with a law degree). Japanese-taught professional degree preparing for the Japanese bar; the former Law School (法務研究科) was reorganised into the Graduate School of Law from April 2025. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants (法務研究科 row): ¥300,000 + ¥1,160,000 = ¥1,460,000 in year 1 and ¥1,360,000 in years 2-3 (not levelled), seminar fee ¥100,000; first-year figures recorded. Replaces an earlier entry taken from a preparatory-school summary, whose figures matched the 2024 table.

programmes.name: School of Political Science and Economics (English-based Degree Program available)
programmes.notes: School of Political Science and Economics row of the 2026 undergraduate fee table (入学金・学費・諸会費一覧). Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,081,000 = ¥1,281,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the engineering entry). Other fees per year (spring + autumn semester) = practical-training fee ¥1,950 x 2 + reading-room library fee ¥250 x 2 + academic society annual fee ¥750 x 2 + health mutual-aid ¥1,500 x 2 = ¥8,900; the ¥2,000 academic society entry fee is paid once. Offers English-based degree programmes in political science, economics and global political economy; the School of International Liberal Studies (SILS, English-taught) is dearer at ¥1,690,000 tuition. 2025 table shows the same amounts; the 2024 table (annual columns) gives practical-training fee ¥4,900, library ¥500, society entry ¥2,000 and annual ¥1,500, health ¥3,000.

programmes.name: School of Commerce
programmes.notes: School of Commerce row of the 2026 undergraduate fee table (入学金・学費・諸会費一覧). Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,051,000 = ¥1,251,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the engineering entry). Other fees per year (spring + autumn) = practical-training fee ¥4,400 x 2 + reading-room library fee ¥400 x 2 + academic society annual fee ¥1,000 x 2 + health mutual-aid ¥1,500 x 2 = ¥14,600; no academic society entry fee. Japanese-taught 4-year degree. 2025 table shows the same amounts; the 2024 table (annual columns) gives practical-training ¥8,800, library ¥800, society ¥2,000, health ¥3,000 (its single society column is read as the annual fee, as in 2025-26).

programmes.name: School of Advanced Science and Engineering (English-based Undergraduate Program available)
programmes.notes: School of Advanced Science and Engineering row of the 2026 undergraduate fee table (入学金・学費・諸会費一覧). Admission fee ¥200,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,584,000 = ¥1,784,000, the same as tuition in years 2-4, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the engineering entry). Other fees per year (spring + autumn) = lab fee ¥50,000 x 2 + health mutual-aid ¥1,500 x 2 = ¥103,000. Physics, applied physics, chemistry, life science and bioscience departments; English-based degree programme offered. Education: School of Education's Department of Science is cheaper (¥1,744,000 tuition). 2024 and 2025 tables show the same amounts (2024: lab ¥100,000 + health ¥3,000).

programmes.name: Graduate School of Asia-Pacific Studies (MA in International Relations, English-taught)
programmes.notes: アジア太平洋研究科 row of the 2026 master's and professional degree fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,406,000 = ¥1,706,000, the same as tuition in year 2, so the admission fee is included in tuition (as for the undergraduate entries). Other fees = health mutual-aid ¥3,000 per year; no seminar fee. Fully English-taught 2-year MA; the Japanese-taught Graduate School of Political Science MA costs ¥922,000 a year. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants: admission ¥300,000 + tuition ¥1,373,000 = ¥1,673,000 in year 1 and tuition ¥1,573,000 in year 2 (the 2024 table was not levelled); the first-year figure is recorded.

programmes.name: Waseda Business School MBA (Graduate School of Business and Finance, full-time 2-year course)
programmes.notes: 経営管理研究科 全日制2年制コース row of the 2026 master's and professional degree fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥1,765,000 = ¥2,065,000, the same as tuition in year 2, so the admission fee is included in tuition. Other fees = health mutual-aid ¥3,000 per year. The full-time 2-year course includes the English-taught International MBA; the 1-year full-time MBA is ¥3,278,000 and the evening 2-year MBA ¥1,877,000. 2025 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥1,665,000 = ¥1,965,000. 2024 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥1,640,000 = ¥1,940,000 in year 1 and ¥1,840,000 in year 2 (not levelled); first-year figures are recorded.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Fundamental Science and Engineering (Master's, Computer Science and Communications Engineering)
programmes.notes: 基幹理工学研究科 情報理工・情報通信専攻 row (shared with mechanical science and aerospace, electronic and physical systems, intermedia studies) of the 2026 master's fee table. Admission fee ¥300,000 + first-year tuition ¥991,000 = ¥1,291,000, the same as tuition in year 2, so the admission fee is included in tuition. Other fees per year = seminar/lab fee ¥96,000 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥99,000. English-based International Graduate Program available. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥962,000 = ¥1,262,000 (year 2 ¥1,162,000, not levelled); the 2024 table gives the lab fee only as a school-wide range ¥70,000-96,000, so the 2024 history entry carries only tuition.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Creative Science and Engineering (Master's, Modern Mechanical Engineering)
programmes.notes: 創造理工学研究科 総合機械工学専攻 row (shared with industrial and management systems engineering and business design) of the 2026 master's fee table. English-based International Graduate Program available. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥962,000 = ¥1,262,000 (year 2 ¥1,162,000, not levelled); the 2024 table gives the lab fee only as a school-wide range ¥90,000-120,000, so the 2024 history entry carries only tuition.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Advanced Science and Engineering (Master's, Physics and Applied Physics)
programmes.notes: 先進理工学研究科 物理学及応用物理学専攻 row (shared with nanoscience/nanoelectronics and cooperative nuclear energy) of the 2026 master's fee table. Other fees per year = seminar/lab fee ¥79,500 + health mutual-aid ¥3,000 = ¥82,500 (chemistry and life science departments ¥89,500-109,500). English-based International Graduate Program available. 2025 table shows the same amounts. 2024 entrants: ¥300,000 + ¥1,071,000 = ¥1,371,000 (year 2 ¥1,271,000, not levelled); the 2024 table gives the lab fee only as a school-wide range ¥40,000-109,500, so the 2024 history entry carries only tuition.
